note: Small new RV park on State Route CC on the east edge of West Plains: one row of back-in sites either side of a gravel drive, with a dog park and mail and package pickup. Mostly monthly renters. --Claude
summary: Own site dorvpark.com + Firefly booking: nightly $50 (June 2027) and monthly on the same 27 back-in FHU sites; all 27 occupied on a November 2026 weeknight and 26 of 27 seven months out; Google 4.6 (15) quoting 'It is all permanent people'. DROP CANDIDATE on long-stay test 4 (traveller share ~4%) and the on-the-fence rule.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (long-stay, on-the-fence rule AWH 2026-10-31): the park reads as mostly monthly residents. Seasonal evidence: Firefly offers 'Nightly' and 'Pay monthly' (ONGOING) on the same 27 'Standard RV Site' units; a one-night search for Tue 11/17/2026 found all 27 'Occupied', and for Tue 06/08/2027 - seven months out - 26 of 27 'Occupied', only Site 15 free at $50; Google's review summary quotes 'It is all permanent people and all back in nobody in the office.'; reviews: 'We have been here for 7 months ... make this our place', 'We have been monthly renters for several months now'; amenities lead with 'Laundry ... for longer stays' and 'Mail & Package Pickup'. The operator's homepage does pitch a 'family-friendly' campground taking reservations and the newest review is a short stay.

FIVE LONG-STAY TESTS: (1) price - $50 a night (June 2027 quote), exactly at the US$50 line, passes; (2) nights for sale - yes, Firefly sells one night with no application, passes; (3) no minimum over 2 nights - a one-night stay booked, passes; (4) at least 1 site in 10 sold nightly - no nightly/monthly split is published, but the engine's free-site count for a future weeknight is 0 of 27 (Nov 2026) and 1 of 27 (June 2027), ~4% - FAILS on the QC measuring method; (5) not a home community - passes (RV sites only). Google 4.6 from only 15 reviews (under 25, so Google can't carry presence; the website does).
